strings.LHH_NEU_CONTROL: {lhh_getnamedef} is controlled by A NEUTRAL PARTY.
strings.LHH_shield_of_the_ordensstaat_desc: Formed of the most elite and loyal members of the SS, The Leibstandarte Heinrich Himmler have taken direct control over the major cities and approaches toward Himmler's base of operations. They have turned the Rhine's Western back into an unbroken network of fortifications, something they had clearly been preparing for years, to face them unprepared is to ask for death.
strings.LHH_shield_of_the_ordensstaat_tt: They will fight to the last to protect the Reichsführer-SS.
